package_note: v2 is produced by ticket PO-04 Codex Asset Fix v1 and corrected by ROUND 2. v1 is audit-only and must not be read from. If v2 does not exist, or if the round-2 acceptance items are not present, STOP and report; do not fall back to v1.
round2_gate: 02-square-product-images holds exactly 36 files, six per size, all named <nn>-executive-office-<size>-<view>.png.
No file named 01-executive-portable-office-<size>-exterior.png survives anywhere in the package.
07-web-variants holds exactly 50 WebP files: 36 gallery, 6 ga, 6 wide, 2 diagrams.
Every path in asset_map.gallery[].prebuilt_webp, .ga_boards[].prebuilt_webp, .media_band[].prebuilt_webp and .spec_diagrams[].prebuilt_webp resolves to an existing file.
If any line above is false, STOP and report. Do not rename, re-encode or substitute to make it true.
webp_policy: Codex has already produced compliant WebP derivatives at the measured settings, verified in the 80-120 KB band. COPY the prebuilt_webp file to the output path. Do NOT re-encode from the PNG master: a second lossy pass costs quality for nothing. Re-encode from source ONLY if a prebuilt_webp file is missing, and say so in the PR. Assert every copied file is 80-120 KB and matches the declared pixel dimensions.

rules.ga_boards: 1800 px starting q88, downscale proportionally only, dimension text verified legible by opening the output
rules.crop: Crop nothing. Adjust quality first, then width, and re-measure.
rules.source_png: Source PNGs are never copied into public/.
rules.loading: The six images of the selected size eager; fetchpriority=high on slide 1 only; the other thirty lazy; explicit width and height on every img; a link rel=preload for slide 1 of the default size carrying the same imagesrcset; GA boards lazy.
rules.measurement: Produce a table of file, width, height, KB for every output and include it in the PR.

gallery_running_order: SAMAN ruling 5 Sep 2026: this product ships three exteriors then three interiors, slides 01-06 in file order. This is a sanctioned deviation from the four-exteriors-then-two-interiors running order and must not be 'corrected'.
